skill.name: image-edit
skill.description: Routes image editing requests to the appropriate RunComfy model for batch edits, multilingual text changes, single-image local edits, or mask-based inpainting through the RunComfy CLI.
skill.summary: Route image edits to the best RunComfy model and CLI input pattern.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, placeholder HTTPS URLs, and documented CLI configuration paths. Confirmed findings are limited to explicit RunComfy CLI setup and run examples, plus a semantic privacy risk from remote processing of prompts and image references. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed SKILL.md content.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before installing the RunComfy CLI, logging in, or running generated runcomfy commands.
Warn users that prompts, image URLs, and mask URLs are sent to RunComfy services before processing sensitive assets.
Document token revocation, prefer RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI, and avoid using shared machines for persistent CLI login state.

content.user_title: Route Image Edits to RunComfy Models
content.value_statement: Choosing the right image editing model can waste time and credits. This skill maps each edit request to the best RunComfy route and prompt pattern.
actual_capabilities: Routes edit requests among Nano Banana Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, Flux Kontext Pro, and Z-Image Turbo Inpaint.
Builds RunComfy CLI invocations with model-specific input fields and output directory guidance.
Supports batch edits for 1 to 20 public HTTPS image URLs through Nano Banana Edit.
Guides multilingual in-image text replacement and multi-reference composition with GPT Image 2 Edit.
Supports mask-driven object removal and region replacement with Z-Image Turbo Inpaint.
Documents prerequisites, model limits, exit codes, token storage, and outbound RunComfy endpoints.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and a valid login or token.
Uses public HTTPS image and mask URLs for the documented model inputs.
Selects one model route per call and does not blend multiple model routes.
Sends prompts and image references to RunComfy remote model services.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Image Variants
use_cases.description: Apply consistent background or watermark changes across a small product image batch.

use_cases.title: Localize Marketing Artwork
use_cases.description: Replace in-image headlines with translated text while preserving layout, brand marks, and photography.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Visual Assets
use_cases.description: Remove unwanted objects from a selected region using a mask and a preservation-focused prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Image Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single general edit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this image with the best RunComfy route. Keep the main subject unchanged and change the background to a clean studio setting.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Product Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for consistent edits across several images.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit these product images as a batch. Keep each product shape and color unchanged, replace the background, and use one aspect ratio.

prompt_templates.title: Localized Text Replacement
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for in-image typography changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace only the poster headline with the provided translated text. Preserve the photo, layout, logo, font weight, and text position.

prompt_templates.title: Masked Region Replacement
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request requiring an image URL and mask URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the mask to replace only the selected background region. Preserve all unmasked edges, lighting, product details, and shadows.

output_examples.input: A user asks to remove overhead cables from a street photo and provides a mask URL.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Z-Image Turbo Inpaint, recommends a low strength value, and preserves rooflines and sky tone outside the mask.

output_examples.input: A team needs a Japanese headline on an existing English poster.
output_examples.output: The skill selects GPT Image 2 Edit and focuses the prompt on replacing only the headline while preserving layout and branding.

output_examples.input: A catalog owner wants the same background change on several product images.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Nano Banana Edit, locks aspect ratio and resolution, and keeps each product identity unchanged.

best_practices: Start prompts with what must stay unchanged before describing the requested edit.
Use public HTTPS URLs that the RunComfy model service can fetch.
Choose mask-driven inpainting when the edit must affect only one region.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated edits in one pass when identity or layout must stay stable.
Do not send sensitive images unless remote processing is approved.
Do not use vague spatial instructions when a region, object, or text area matters.

faq.question: Does this skill edit images locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to send requests to RunComfy remote model services.

faq.question: Which model is used by default?
faq.answer: Nano Banana Edit is the default route when the user does not specify a more specialized edit need.

faq.question: Can it edit several images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The Nano Banana route documents batch editing for 1 to 20 public HTTPS image URLs.

faq.question: Can it replace text inside an image?
faq.answer: Yes. The GPT Image 2 route is documented for multilingual in-image text replacement and layout-preserving changes.

faq.question: When should I use a mask?
faq.answer: Use a mask when only one object, background area, or region should change.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI requires a RunComfy login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN environment variable.
